reader_summary.overview: Today we’re replaying our Breakdown on Boeing, hosted by Zack Fuss. We recorded the episode in September before the mid-air blowout on a Boeing 737 operated by Alaska Airlines and the subsequent management changes. It also pairs well with the breakdown we’re releasing next about Brazilian-based airplane manufacturer Embraer.

key_points.text: We recorded the episode in September before the mid-air blowout on a Boeing 737 operated by Alaska Airlines and the subsequent management changes.
So look out for that, and in the meantime, enjoy this episode on Boeing.
